Name: Leelo's Brown Tabby Cat
Author: LeeloMods
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/center]

Adds a cute brown tabby cat to the game. This cat is based on my cat, Dean, pictured below. This cat sprite comes with a unique sleeping animation, replacing the normal laying down animation.  Hats are fully functional with this cat sprite!

[center][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b][/center]

Download with a mod manager for automatic installation. For manual installation, download the .zip mod folder into the StardewValley\Mods folder, extract all from the .zip folder into the same filepath (StardewValley\Mods), and you are all set.

This cat sprite serves as a standalone option, but it is also part of mod bundle that comes with a tuxedo cat, a tortoiseshell cat, and an orange cow cat. See my other mod, Leelo's Cats, to view that bundle.

You do [b]not[/b] need to start a new game. The added cat can be adopted from the start or from Marnie's shop later on.

[color=#ff00ff]Remember to endorse the mod! This helps with visibility, allowing even more Stardew players to enjoy my content [/color]


[center][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[b] [/b]
[size=3]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher for full integration.[/size]

[center][b][size=4]Meet the Model[/size][/b][/center]

      
[center][img width=500,height=500]https://i.imgur.com/fzvTrDf.jpeg[/img][/center]
[center]  Dean is a 9 year old brown tabby. He is very shy, but very sweet once he becomes comfortable around you. He was adopted from a local animal shelter when he was 6 years old after his previous owner was evicted from their home. He loves food, getting brushed, and tummy pets.[/center]
